page_title: HOF 3-2 HOL | Hoffenheim v Holstein Kiel 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Tobias Stieler is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' The attendance is 18503.
90+4' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) was quite harsh and Tobias Stieler didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Here is a change. Andrej Kramaric is going off and Pellegrino Matarazzo gives the last tactical orders to Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Stanley Nsoki (Hoffenheim) coming on for Alexander Prass.

89' 3 - 2 What a wonderful finish! Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and drills a low shot into the bottom left corner. There are not enough superlatives to describe that goal.
87' 3 - 1 Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) pounces on a rebound inside the box from a Jacob Bruun Larsen shot and sends the ball into the back of the net. The score is 3:1.
87' Marvin Schulz floats over the corner and Patrick Erras (Holstein Kiel) gets on the end of it, but his header from around the penalty spot sails well wide of the left post.
86' Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

86' Oliver Baumann was forced into action to thwart Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
84' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Timon Weiner, who smothers the ball.
84' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) takes the corner with a short pass.
83' The free kick is taken by Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim), but ball is cleared. Hoffenheim get a corner.
82' Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) sees a yellow card in the hand of Tobias Stieler. And as it's a second one this game, a red follows and Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) is sent from the pitch.
82' Marcel Rapp has decided to make a change. Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) replaces Lewis Holtby.
81' Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
80' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) is brought on as a substitute for Magnus Knudsen.
79' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
76' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
74' The resulting corner, taken by Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel), comes to nothing.
73' Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
72' Surely that's handball by one of the Hoffenheim players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
71' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
69' Pellegrino Matarazzo has decided to substitute Florian Grillitsch and he is replaced by Dennis Geiger (Hoffenheim).
68' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Marius Bulter walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jacob Bruun Larsen (Hoffenheim).
67' Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Timon Weiner comes off his line to gather the ball.
63' 2 - 1 Goal! Finn Porath picks out Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) in the box with a decent cross, and he scores in the roof of the net with a header from close range. 2:1.
62' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) launches a cross from the corner, but Oliver Baumann is alert to thwart the effort.

61' Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) hammers a powerful first-time shot from close range, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper stops it with a miraculous save. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Holstein Kiel.
61' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
59' Pellegrino Matarazzo decides to make a substitution. Adam Hlozek will be replaced by Mergim Berisha (Hoffenheim).

58' Andu Yobel Kelati sprays a wonderful pass out to Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Oliver Baumann problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the left post.
57' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit.
54' Substitution. Benedikt Pichler will be replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).
54' Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Timon Weiner is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
53' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim).
53' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) works the corner short.
53' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is out of play and Hoffenheim manage to earn a corner.
51' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) is teed up by Anton Stach, but his shot from distance is yards wide of the left post.
49' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
49' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) receives the ball in space inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends his first-time shot well wide of the right post.
48' A clumsy foul by Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle.
47' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

46' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Hoffenheim have a corner.
46' Half-time substitution. Tymoteusz Puchacz will not participate anymore and Andu Yobel Kelati (Holstein Kiel) is coming on.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Marco Komenda is replaced by Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel).
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+5' Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
45+3' Anton Stach (Hoffenheim) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
45+3' A quickly taken corner by Hoffenheim.

45+3' Great save! Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Timon Weiner. Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

44' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the top of the net. His effort is blocked by Timon Weiner with a brilliant diving save! The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim have been awarded a corner kick.

42' The ball is cleared out of defence to the edge of the box where Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel) hits a first-time shot back towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the ball flashes well past the right post.
42' The corner from Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by the defence.

41' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Hoffenheim will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Lewis Holtby lays the ball off to Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel), who hurriedly shoots from long range and sends the ball high over the bar into row Z.

37' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) bursts into the box to get on the end of a whipped in cross from Marius Bulter and scores magnificently from close range low into the middle of the goal. 2:0.
36' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel). Tobias Stieler saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick to Hoffenheim.
32' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) will take a corner kick.
29' Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

29' What a save from Oliver Baumann! Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. Good work from Holstein Kiel as they win a corner.
26' Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel) gets his head on the corner, but he can't find the target as his header flies high over the crossbar.
26' Lewis Holtby (Holstein Kiel) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.

25' Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the right post. Oliver Baumann guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Holstein Kiel.
24' Tim Drexler (Hoffenheim) sends a long ball forward to Adam Hlozek, but he put too much power and the chance is gone.
22' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
21' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) darts into the box and immediately fires a first-time effort that ends well wide of the right post.
19' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
17' Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel) sends a long ball in, but Oliver Baumann comfortably gathers the ball.
14' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) has tested the patience of referee Tobias Stieler and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
14' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
13' Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
12' Marius Bulter (Hoffenheim) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) tries to find Lewis Holtby, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Hoffenheim will have a goal kick.
11' Adam Hlozek (Hoffenheim) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Pavel Kaderabek. The ball is out of play. Holstein Kiel will take a throw-in.
7' Lewis Holtby plays the ball through to Shuto Machino (Holstein Kiel) on the edge of the box, he turns and shoots but it's a fraction wide of the left post.
6' 1 - 0 Goal! Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Timon Weiner to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
6' Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
5' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Timon Weiner (Holstein Kiel).
4' Timon Weiner (Holstein Kiel) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

4' Timon Weiner (Holstein Kiel) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A penalty is awarded to Hoffenheim!
3' Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Hoffenheim.
3' Florian Grillitsch (Hoffenheim) commits a rough challenge and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for an infringement.
